title: Swimmers on Rocky Cliff, Summer River Outing - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical black-and-white vintage snapshot capturing a group of youths gathered on a sunlit rock ledge above a deep river swimming hole. Several figures in swimsuits stand atop the jagged rock formation while others peer down, with one figure caught near the edge about to dive or scramble down toward the dark, calm water below. The background features a steep, forested hillside. This candid image reflects early 20th-century American summer leisure, highlighting youthful outdoor adventures, swimming traditions, and nature exploration.
